title: wk-tool first-use nudge (howto)
desc: How the per-session first-use nudge maps a wk tool to its skill and blocks first use until read.
steps: MECHANISM: on the FIRST use of a wk-prefixed tool in a session, the nudge blocks the call once and requires reading that tool's skill, so the operator studies the tool before relying on it.

TOOL-TO-SKILL MAP: strip the leading wk from the tool name, then a skill whose id contains that token (token-boundary or prefix) satisfies it -- wkcodex by codex-tool-wrappers, wkagy by antigravity-cli-agy-integration-guide, wkhippo by hippocampus-living-memory. Genuinely-semantic names with no shared token need an explicit tool-to-skill map entry.
SCOPE: wk tools ONLY (the nudge is gated to the wk namespace); git/gh/Agent are not nudged. Reading the mapped skill once clears the nudge for the rest of the session.
author: claude
